title: Panel on the LP-EM-CC35X1: 9 wires
warning: Unplug both USB cables before every wire. VCC goes to 3.3 V, not 5 V.

label: Unplug USB. Power: 2 wires
red (VCC) to BP.1 (3V3), top-left pin of P1
black (GND) to BP.22 (GND), next to the 5V pin
• Use 3.3 V: the module's level translator sits on
a 3.3 V rail; 5 V was not tried
• Leave loose: 3V3 (orange), SD_CS (white) and
the 4 touch wires (not used by this image)
• The silkscreen prints the chip ball number, not
the GPIO: BP.7 reads P18, BP.14 P17, BP.15 P16
Pixels: 3 wires (SPI0)
green (SCLK) to BP.7 (GPIO27, P18): the clock
blue (MOSI) to BP.15 (GPIO29, P16): pixel data
yellow (MISO) to BP.14 (GPIO28, P17): optional
• MISO only lets a program read the screen back;
the Doom image does not use it
Control: 4 wires (GPIO)
purple (LCD_CS) to BP.18 (GPIO26, P19)
brown (LCD_DC) to BP.37 (GPIO16, P30)
grey (LCD_RST) to BP.38 (GPIO19, P27)
2nd blue (LCD_BL) to BP.30 (GPIO31, P13)
• CS, DC, RST: "listen", command or pixels, restart
• Screen dark? Move LCD_BL to BP.1 (3V3)

task_facts.head: For this panel
items: SPI0 (SCLK, MOSI), 4 GPIO outputs, 3V3 and GND: 9 wires. MISO is an optional 10th
Doom's three demos in 320 x 168 pixels, one to one, in the top 168 of 480 rows (no scaling)
No keys, no sound; the touch chip is not read. The SPI clock is 16 MHz by default
